title: System, Method, and Digital Public Infrastructure Architecture for Blotter-Direct Sovereign Clearing, Real-Time Fiscal Revenue Ingestion, and Float Sovereignty in Emerging Markets: A Case Study of Tanzania
description:
A formal macroeconomic and systems engineering technical disclosure establishing defensive prior art for a Sovereign Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) payment rail and real-time fiscal revenue ingestion architecture operating directly on a 256-lane Layer-1 settlement blotter. Using the United Republic of Tanzania as the primary operational reference model, this specification addresses the systemic failure modes of closed-loop private mobile money cartels (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo/Yas), predatory citizen tolling (1.5% to 3.5%), the failure of stacked mobile money levies under the Finance Act 2021, and the loss of national float sovereignty across commercial banks.

The disclosure codifies: (1) Common-carrier telecommunications routing under EPOCA §26 where licensed carriers act as dumb data pipes receiving a regulated cost-plus transport tariff (20 TZS / 0.02%); (2) National identity key derivation pairing biometric National Identification Authority (NIDA) NIN credentials directly to Ed25519 sovereign accounts; (3) Invariant 9 (SigmaDebits == SigmaCredits + SigmaFees, Delta=0) continuous solvency fee conservation executing an automated, real-time 18 basis point (0.18%) fiscal revenue split directly into the Ministry of Finance Treasury Single Account (TSA) at the central bank in the exact millisecond of settlement, yielding ~252 Billion TZS annually in un-evadable public revenue; (4) Re-centralization of multi-trillion TZS mobile money trust float into the Bank of Tanzania Sovereign Reserve Pool; and (5) Disaster and rural off-grid settlement continuity via SYN-TD-014 144-byte Sub-GHz LoRa radio mesh vouchers. Published pursuant to 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) and EPC Article 54(2) establishing defensive prior art.
